{{Quote|His obsession with both is what drove Nuso Esva off Oristrom and gave you the freedom to be here today.|[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir]] [[Fel dynasty|Fel]], to [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], on Grand Admiral Thrawn|<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref>}}
'''Oristrom''' was an [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> located in the [[Oristrom system/Legends|eponymous]] [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the strong&ndash;willed [[Stromma]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the world was controlled by the [[Stromma council]], an organization that led all Stromma planets.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> during a [[Battle of the Poln system|battle]] in the [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]<ref name="COC">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref> of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Poln">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]</ref> [[Storm-hair|alien]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]]{{'s}} gloating, which stated the Stromma's fate if they chose to join [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]], was shared by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] through the [[DeepWater-class light freighter|''DeepWater''-class light freighter]] ''[[Lost Reef]]''{{'s}} modified [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] with the Stromma. After Esva learnt of that, he promised Thrawn that once he finished off Thrawn's forces, he would travel to<ref name="COC" /> Oristrom<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> and turn the Stromma into "useful" tools. However, his [[Eastern Fleet|fleet]] was destroyed and he did not destroy the senior captain.<ref name="COC" />

At some point after the battle in the Poln system, the Stromma [[Battle of Oristrom|engaged]] Esva's [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]], the [[Chosen (Nuso Esva)|Chosen]], on the Stromma homeworld. The Stromma had the upper hand; however, Esva assumed personal [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] and turned the tide of the battle. The [[Empire of the Hand]], a successor of the Galactic Empire in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] allied with the Stromma, defeated the warlord's forces thanks to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn's obsession with art.<ref name="COC" />
